# HTTP API

Every route except `/health` needs an `x-api-key` header holding one of
the keys in `API_KEYS`. Every response, errors included, has one shape:

```json
{"success": true, "data": ..., "error": null}
```

On an error, `success` is `false`, `data` is `null` and `error` is a
fixed message. [Using cowbird from an agent](../guides/use-from-an-agent.md)
lists the status codes.

## `GET /health`

Liveness. No API key needed.

`data` on success:

```json
{"status": "ok"}
```

## `GET /v1/providers`

The health matrix: measured status and median latency per provider.

`data` on success:

```json
[{"provider": "mailtm", "status": "ok", "p50": 1.36, "kind": ["own-domain"], "sites": ["mail.tm"]}]
```

## `DELETE /v1/providers/{name}/quarantine`

Return a quarantined provider to routing, on every instance. `404` for an unknown provider.

| Parameter | In | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | required |

`data` on success:

```json
{"cleared": true}
```

## `POST /v1/inboxes`

Issue an address from the best healthy provider that matches the filters. Every field is optional; send no body for any provider.

JSON body:

| Field | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | string or null | unset |
| `kind` | Kind or null | unset |
| `local` | string or null | unset |
| `domain` | string or null | unset |
| `domain_not_in` | array of string | `[]` |
| `address_ttl_seconds` | integer or null | unset |
| `message_ttl_seconds` | integer or null | unset |
| `push` | boolean or null | unset |
| `delete` | boolean or null | unset |
| `self_hosted` | boolean or null | unset |
| `inbox_privacy` | InboxPrivacy or null | unset |

`data` on success:

```json
{"address": "cb1f0a2e@example.test", "provider": "mailtm", "expires_at": null}
```

## `GET /v1/inboxes/{addr}/messages`

List the messages in an inbox this server issued. `404` for an address it did not issue.

| Parameter | In | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addr` | path | string | required |

`data` on success:

```json
[{"id": "m1", "sender": "noreply@example.test", "subject": "Your code", "received_at": "2026-11-21T10:00:00+00:00", "locked": false}]
```

## `GET /v1/inboxes/{addr}/messages/{message_id}`

One message in full, with its links and any one-time code found in it.

| Parameter | In | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addr` | path | string | required |
| `message_id` | path | string | required |

`data` on success:

```json
{"id": "m1", "sender": "noreply@example.test", "subject": "Your code", "received_at": "2026-11-21T10:00:00+00:00", "html": "...", "text": "Your code is 482913", "links": [], "otp": "482913"}
```

## `DELETE /v1/inboxes/{addr}/messages/{message_id}`

Delete a message, where the provider supports it.

| Parameter | In | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addr` | path | string | required |
| `message_id` | path | string | required |

`data` on success:

```json
{"deleted": "m1"}
```

## `GET /v1/inboxes/{addr}/wait`

Long-poll for the next message. Held at most `WAIT_MAX` seconds whatever `timeout` asks; on no mail `data` is `null`, so ask again. With `otp=true`, waits for a message that holds a code. `skip` is a comma-separated list of message ids to ignore, for a second message after a first.

| Parameter | In | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addr` | path | string | required |
| `timeout` | query | integer or null | unset |
| `otp` | query | boolean | off |
| `skip` | query | string or null | unset |

`data` on success:

```json
{"id": "m1", "sender": "...", "subject": "...", "received_at": "...", "html": "...", "text": "...", "links": [], "otp": "482913"}
```

## `POST /v1/webhooks`

Register a one-shot webhook: the server waits for the next message, then POSTs it to `url` once. `timeout` is capped at `WEBHOOK_MAX`. Private and loopback URLs are refused with `422`.

JSON body:

| Field | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `address` | string | required |
| `url` | string | required |
| `timeout` | integer | `25` |

`data` on success:

```json
{"id": "h1"}
```

## `GET /v1/webhooks`

Pending webhooks on this instance.

`data` on success:

```json
[{"id": "h1", "address": "...", "url": "https://example.test/hook", "timeout": 25}]
```

## `DELETE /v1/webhooks/{hook_id}`

Cancel a pending webhook.

| Parameter | In | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hook_id` | path | string | required |

`data` on success:

```json
{"cancelled": true}
```

## Enumerations

- `InboxPrivacy`: `private`, `public`, `shared`
- `Kind`: `gmail-alias`, `outlook-alias`, `own-domain`, `edu`
